good_tips: Swim up for air
Get to the surface before your air runs out
Surface for air, then punch a tree for wood
labels.notes: Spawned underwater with an empty inventory. The urgent tip is air (swim up); a thorough coach may mention Respiration later. Getting wood is a fine follow-up.

good_tips: Turn your wood into planks and make a crafting table
Craft a crafting table from four planks
labels.notes: Punching a tree and picking up the first log. Next step is planks and a crafting table.

good_tips: Wooden pickaxes break fast; mine stone for stone tools
Find stone and upgrade to stone tools
bad_tips: Use the wooden pickaxe to mine iron
labels.notes: Just crafted a wooden pickaxe. Tip: low durability, get cobblestone for stone tools.

good_tips: Monsters spawn at night; get under cover or sleep in a bed
Find shelter before mobs spawn
labels.notes: Outside at night with no armor. Tip: shelter or bed, hostile mobs spawn at night.

good_tips: Kill the pig for food; you have none
Get food from that pig
labels.notes: A pig is visible in the distance and the inventory has no food.

good_tips: Storm at night; find shelter or a bed
Get inside, mobs spawn in thunderstorms
bad_tips: Climb a tall tree to look around
labels.notes: Lightning strikes at night during a thunderstorm. Tip: shelter or sleep.

good_tips: Find a house with a bed in the village and sleep
Villages have beds; sleep through the night
Villagers trade valuable items for emeralds
labels.notes: Found a village at night in a thunderstorm. Best tip: find a bed in a house and sleep; a bonus tip is that villagers trade.

good_tips: Berry bushes hurt you when you walk through them
Step out of the berry bush
labels.notes: Taking damage from walking through a sweet berry bush. Show a warning.

good_tips: A stonecutter crafts stone blocks, stairs and slabs with less waste
Use the stonecutter to cut stone into stairs, slabs and walls
labels.notes: Opened a village door and sees a stonecutter. Tip on what it does.

good_tips: Sleep in that bed to skip the night
Use the bed to skip the night and set spawn
labels.notes: Spots a bed at night. Tip: sleep to skip the night.

good_tips: Don't fight the zombie without armor; back off
Avoid that zombie, you have no armor
labels.notes: A zombie appears; the player has no armor. Warn against fighting.

good_tips: Eat and get somewhere safe
Cook the raw porkchop before eating it
Don't eat rotten flesh, it makes you hungry
bad_tips: Fight the next mob you see
labels.notes: Low health and hungry. Inventory has raw porkchop (cook it) and rotten flesh (causes Hunger). Tip: eat, get safe; cooking pork is better.

good_tips: Eat something
You're hungry, eat food to regenerate health
labels.notes: Still hungry a few seconds later. Tip: eat. (Overlaps 03:25; a coach that already said this may reasonably stay quiet.)

good_tips: Tame the wolf by giving it bones
Feed that wolf bones to tame it
labels.notes: Meets a wolf. Tip: tame it with bones.
Just exploring after 04:13. Nothing needs saying; a good coach stays quiet.
Just exploring after 04:13. Nothing needs saying; a good coach stays quiet.
